scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix points install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix web install && npm --prefix desktop install
scripts.seed: npm --prefix points run seed && npm --prefix server run seed
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n points,api,web -c yellow,magenta,cyan "npm --prefix points run dev" "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix web run dev"
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix server run typecheck && npm --prefix web run typecheck
scripts.desktop: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n points,api,web,app -c yellow,magenta,cyan,green "npm --prefix points run dev" "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix web run dev" "wait-on http://localhost:5173 && npm --prefix desktop start"
